data.headline: Senior Technical Leader / Embedded Engineer | Driving Cross-Functional Delivery in Medical Devices, Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Aerospace
data.about:
Jay is a Senior Embedded Software Engineer at Medtronic with comprehensive expertise across hardware and software, ranging from low-level circuit design to high-level embedded applications.

He has served in pivotal engineering roles at Raytheon Technologies, MIT Lincoln Laboratory, Amazon Robotics, and ASML, where he contributed to the development of advanced systems in national defense, robotics, and semiconductor manufacturing.

Jay earned his M.S. in Electrical Engineering from Northeastern University and his B.S. in Computer Engineering from the University of Connecticut. He brings a rigorous interdisciplinary approach to addressing complex technical challenges, driving innovation across both research and industry domains.
data.addressWithCountry: Greater Minneapolis-St. Paul Area United States

description.text:
As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer within Medtronic’s Pelvic Health and Neuromodulation portfolio, I tested and developed embedded software systems for Class III medical devices. My work spans firmware development, test automation, tooling infrastructure, and system-level integration—all within the constraints of strict regulatory compliance. I focus on driving efficiency, scalability, and software quality across the product lifecycle.

Key Contributions:

* Led the design and development of a hardware test system that automated verification workflows, significantly improving test efficiency and repeatability for neuromodulation devices.

* Developed a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) neurostimulator simulator, enabling accurate, high-fidelity testing to support system validation and functional verification.

* Designed and implemented a custom unit testing framework with integrated code coverage reporting, elevating code quality and supporting compliance with IEC 62304 and FDA standards.

* Owned and enhanced the CI/CD pipeline, integrating custom tooling and automated checks to accelerate development cycles and maintain high software quality.

* Built internal tooling infrastructure that improved team productivity, enforced design controls, and streamlined development processes across firmware and systems teams.

* Drafted, reviewed, and verified software and system requirements, aligning engineering output with product and regulatory specifications.

* Mentored junior engineers and led Agile scrums, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration.

Led cross-functional development of mixed-signal PCAs and precision electromechanical assemblies for advanced semiconductor lithography platforms. Delivered production-ready subsystems that enhanced system performance, manufacturability, and yield.

Key Achievements

	•	Spearheaded design and integration of FPGA-based control boards and analog sensor modules for sub-micron positioning systems.
	•	Optimized system-level electrical performance through noise analysis and signal conditioning, improving stability and repeatability in wafer alignment systems.
	•	Directed design reviews, FMEAs, and validation plans that enabled a $150M product launch on schedule and within performance targets.
	•	Authored comprehensive design documentation and interface specifications, reinforcing compliance and cross-domain integration.

Delivered advanced aerospace and undersea systems through end-to-end hardware and firmware design. Drove initiatives in embedded communication, signal processing, and system reliability.

Key Achievements

	•	Developed a Python-based sensor simulation framework that reduced hardware validation time by 60%.
	•	Designed custom embedded boards and FPGA interfaces for mission-critical systems operating under extreme environmental constraints.
	•	Implemented and optimized low-level C/VHDL protocols to achieve deterministic, high-throughput communication between FPGA and MCU subsystems.
	•	Executed power optimization and signal integrity analysis, improving reliability margins under thermal and EMI constraints.

Supported design of robotic sensing and perception systems for next-generation autonomous fulfillment robots.

Key Achievements

	•	Contributed to three successful ASIC and PCB tape-outs integrating ultrasonic and image sensors with on-board image processors.
	•	Performed signal integrity and noise analysis to optimize radar module performance and environmental robustness.
	•	Collaborated with cross-functional hardware and perception teams to translate sensing requirements into manufacturable board designs.

Selected from over 3,000 applicants for a defense research fellowship in autonomous UAV systems and advanced surveillance hardware. Contributed to design, fabrication, and validation of mixed-signal electronics for space and airborne platforms.

Key Achievements

	•	Designed and fabricated analog protection and telemetry circuits, achieving two successful ASIC tape-outs.
	•	Developed flight-ready electronics for an autonomous coaxial UAV deployable from military aircraft, supporting range and payload optimization.
	•	Presented research findings at Lincoln Lab’s Rapid Prototyping Group, demonstrating rigorous analytical and system modeling capability.

* Diagnosed and repaired hardware issues, including laptops, desktops, and peripherals.
* Built and configured computers, ensuring full system functionality.
* Installed and deployed operating systems on leased machines, enabling seamless end-user readiness.
